title: SparseBitMatrix::matvec prefetch + block-CSR layout
description:
Add an opt-in block-CSR layout and software-prefetch-capable sparse matvec path for `SparseBitMatrix`, while preserving the existing CSR matvec path for current callers.

## Background

`SparseBitMatrix::matvec` in `crates/gf2-core/src/sparse.rs` does scalar CSR iteration. The gather pattern reads sparse column indices and follows them into the input vector, which can be cache-unfriendly for LDPC-sized matrices. The implementation adds a separate block-CSR transformer and matvec entrypoint so callers can opt into the experimental layout without changing existing CSR behavior.

## Amendment Note

User-approved amendment after a focused rework and fixed-iteration perf harness showed the original hard performance criterion was not met on this host/fixture. Evidence in `dev/benchmarks/f1a896f0-perf-stat.txt` records fixed 50,000-matvec comparisons for `8192x16384_w6`: CSR L1d miss rate `2.61%` and `1.739s`, block-CSR no-prefetch `3.92%` and `2.027s`, block-CSR prefetch distance 16 `3.43%` and `2.513s`. Therefore the accepted deliverable is the correctness-tested opt-in scaffold plus honest evidence; existing CSR remains the default production path, and prefetch remains explicit rather than enabled by default.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. existing CSR matvec.
- [hard] Block-CSR transformer is a separate function; existing CSR path unchanged for callers that do not opt in.
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact shows prefetch instructions actually emitted.
- [hard] Fixed-iteration `perf stat -r 10` evidence compares CSR, block-CSR without prefetch, and block-CSR with explicit prefetch on an LDPC-sized sparse bench, and records that block-CSR/prefetch do not beat CSR on the measured fixture.
- [hard] Word-boundary `#[test]`s pass for the transformer.
- [hard] Default production sparse matvec remains the existing CSR path; block-CSR and prefetch are opt-in until future evidence shows a win.
- [aspirational] Future sparse-layout work finds a layout/prefetch combination with >=1.5x geomean speedup on LDPC parity-check sizes.

## Notes

Cache-bound kernel: the measured branch did not improve miss rate or runtime vs CSR on the fixed harness. Follow-up work should try a more substantial layout change, such as row-block accumulator tiling or interleaved edge slots, before enabling block-CSR/prefetch by default. Bench: `sparse` and `sparse_block_csr_perfstat`. Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
